operationContracts.name: 浏览并刷新工作树及关联会话
operationContracts.trigger: Open the general worktrees tab or press Refresh.
operationContracts.guard: Worktree query requires available host settings; preserve loading/error/empty states, local-environment-root exclusion, repo grouping and visible conversation rules.
operationContracts.effect: codex-worktrees via git service with hostConfig, operationSource=worktrees_settings_page and worktreesRoot; Refresh runs worktree and conversation refetches in parallel.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Aggregate error is worktree ?? local-environment-roots ?? conversation error. Selected Refresh callback has no local catch; no explicit page-level cancellation control.

operationContracts.name: 设置工作树根目录
operationContracts.trigger: Edit the root input; blur or enabled CmdOrCtrl+S.
operationContracts.guard: $t hides preference controls without host settings. Root edits are ignored while pending; save requires changed draft and !pending, trims it, and accepts empty or the imported valid-path predicate plus host-home-selected path.isAbsolute.
operationContracts.effect: Host-specific nga/tft writes git- worktreeRoot descriptor key git-worktree-root; success clears draft and shows success.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Invalid input makes no request; failure retains draft and shows error. Path scheme is selected from host codexHome, not simply the renderer OS. No explicit cancel action.
operationContracts.stateAndPersistence: host configuration; key git-worktree-root; default empty

operationContracts.name: 设置创建工作树前刷新上游
operationContracts.trigger: Toggle Always fetch upstream before creating worktrees.
operationContracts.guard: Disabled while its mutation is pending; direct onChange maps true to best-effort and false to never without an extra handler guard.
operationContracts.effect: Shared settings writer for upstreamRefreshMode (worktree-upstream-refresh-mode); source initializer $pt=never is pinned, initialization order/runtime effective value unverified.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Error toast on save failure; no operation-level cancel or proof of an actual fetch.

operationContracts.name: 设置自动清理旧工作树
operationContracts.trigger: Toggle automatic deletion; confirm when disabling.
operationContracts.guard: Pending checkbox suppressed. Enabling writes true directly; disabling opens a dialog and only confirmation writes false, clears count draft and closes dialog. Cancel closes dialog without writing.
operationContracts.effect: Host-specific writer for worktree-auto-cleanup-enabled, descriptor default true; success feedback reflects submitted boolean.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Failure shows error; no compensating cleanup operation or deletion is performed by this toggle handler.

operationContracts.name: 设置自动清理保留工作树数量
operationContracts.trigger: Edit numeric limit; blur or Enter.
operationContracts.guard: Disabled if count mutation or cleanup mutation is pending or cleanup disabled. Trim then parseInt(base10), blank/NaN clear draft, clamp to at least1; unchanged clears draft without writing.
operationContracts.effect: Host-specific writer for worktree-keep-count, descriptor default15 and integer>=1 schema; successful write clears draft.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Failure retains draft and shows error. Page parseInt also accepts a numeric prefix, e.g. 3garbage ->3; HTML numeric input does not replace source-level acceptance rules.

operationContracts.name: 打开工作树关联的会话
operationContracts.trigger: Click a visible known conversation row.
operationContracts.guard: Rows use linked data filtered to pinned or non-subagent conversations; loading and empty states are explicit.
operationContracts.effect: Invoke imported imt navigation callback with conversation.id and selected hostId.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Navigation/service failure and later thread loading are delegated; no local error/cancel handler is present in this row callback.
operationContracts.stateAndPersistence: navigation selection; not a saved preference

operationContracts.name: 在已有工作树开始新会话
operationContracts.trigger: Click New chat in this worktree.
operationContracts.guard: Shown for local host kind unless the selected source conversation belongs to the excluded local project kind/id condition; disabled while this worktree deletion state is pending.
operationContracts.effect: Invoke imported TU helper with sourceConversationId from the first pinned/non-subagent native conversation, optionally undefined, and workspaceRoot=worktree.dir.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: The source supplies workspace reuse intent; actual task creation, first turn, navigation and errors remain behind TU. No automatic first-message submission is proven.

operationContracts.name: 删除指定工作树及归档其本地会话
operationContracts.trigger: Click Delete on a worktree row.
operationContracts.guard: Button disabled while conversations load or a native conversation is pinned. gn separately suppresses repeated work and refreshes pins before any archive/delete.
operationContracts.effect: When unpinned, await all supplied native conversation archives with cleanupWorktree:false and source=worktree_delete, then worktree-delete {hostId,worktree,reason:settings-delete-targeted}, invalidate host list, show success.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Pin presence warns and returns. Exceptions are caught/logged, show danger, and finally release pending. Partial archives or a successful deletion followed by invalidate error are not compensated; no explicit user cancellation or confirmation is added by this selected handler.
operationContracts.stateAndPersistence: archive and git deletion service effects; actual file recovery unobserved

operationContracts.name: 搜索可配置的键盘快捷键
operationContracts.trigger: Search text or switch to keystroke search.
operationContracts.guard: Available command set is filtered by platform, capabilities, feature flags, registered commands and presentation. Text uses command id/title/description; keystroke mode matches complete stroke prefixes, supports a compatible sequence, ignores repeat and bare Escape exits/clears.
operationContracts.effect: Update local search/mode state only; external-browser and number-target rows have separate search visibility rules.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Loading keymap shows loading; no-match state differs from active search auxiliaries. No persistence or backend cancellation is claimed for local search.

operationContracts.name: 编辑或恢复单项命令快捷键
operationContracts.trigger: Capture a keybinding, append/remove a binding, reset one command or clear it where the presentation permits.
operationContracts.guard: ve disables controls while pending. Sequence and bare-modifier support depend on command kind/id. Conflict checks include fixed Find, registered commands and both directions of sequence-prefix overlap; annotation mode has additional restrictions.
operationContracts.effect: set-codex-command-keybinding {commandId,update}: set/append/replace(previousAccelerator,accelerator)/remove(accelerator)/reset/clear as source branches select. ChatGPT composer Enter can select reset. Success updates/invalidates keymap and related hotkey caches.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Cancel capture clears editor state without writing; conflicts keep editor state and show message. RPC failure is caught by row wrapper and shown inline; later editor-close behavior differs by presentation and preserves newer capture state by identity.
operationContracts.stateAndPersistence: keymap RPC and OS registration/durable store

operationContracts.name: 批量恢复快捷键默认值
operationContracts.trigger: Click reset/restore defaults and confirm when required.
operationContracts.guard: Suppress while reset busy. Codex presentation opens confirmation then resets all keybindings and, when its preference exists, external-browser modifier in parallel. ChatGPT presentation directly resets eligible customized commands sequentially, limited to the focused customized command if present; the search-filtered result list is not its reset scope.
operationContracts.effect: On complete success close dialog; keep cache refresh behavior of each mutation.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Cancel confirmation writes nothing. Partial failures show an error and release busy; no rollback of successful sibling resets or preference writes. Focus changes the ChatGPT branch scope.
operationContracts.stateAndPersistence: keymap RPC plus shared external-browser preference

operationContracts.name: 设置数字快捷键切换聊天或标签页
operationContracts.guard: Number-target row is gated by unified-tab-strip/search conditions. Trigger disabled while saving; same-value selections have no callback equality check. Existing custom-binding conflicts are shown as a notice rather than blocking write.
operationContracts.effect: Shared writer for primary-number-shortcut-target, descriptor default tabs; labels vary with macOS Command/Control vs other platform Control/Alt.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Failure sets inline error and finally clears pending; actual key dispatch and persisted value require separate observation.

operationContracts.name: 设置点击链接时使用系统浏览器的修饰键
operationContracts.trigger: Choose unassigned, primary, alt or primary-shift.
operationContracts.guard: Row requires non-ChatGPT presentation, an available preference and matching search mode/query. Pending disables trigger; selected-equal value is suppressed.
operationContracts.effect: Shared writer for external-browser-link-shortcut, default primary; global Codex reset can also restore its default.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Failure shows inline error; finally releases pending. Actual link opening and OS target remain consumer boundaries.

operationContracts.name: 查看并重试文件类型处理器发现
operationContracts.trigger: Open file-type handlers or click Retry.
operationContracts.guard: Normalize extensions by trim/removing leading dots/lowercase, remove empty, deduplicate/sort. Discovery failure includes either query error or any toolsError; initial empty loading, empty success and refetch feedback are distinct.
operationContracts.effect: Retry calls primary refetch and optional auxiliary refetch only when its isEnabled flag is true, in one Promise.all.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Selected retry callback does not catch its returned rejection locally; failed UI offers retry. No preference mutation or explicit cancellation control.

operationContracts.name: 选择文件类型的首选查看器
operationContracts.trigger: Choose Built-in/default or one eligible plugin viewer for an extension.
operationContracts.guard: Skip a row if bot cannot form a preference key. Use extension-specific eligible viewers sorted by title; bot/Izi resolve the longest matching suffix and key JSON([hostId,extension]). Row selection accepts default or an available viewer identity; resolver/default policy remains a boundary.
operationContracts.effect: Rw queues a latest-map merge into preferred-file-viewers. Viewer id is JSON([server,tool.name,resourceUri,pluginId??null]); optimistic row selection uses an incrementing request id.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Only the latest row request can set error and clear pending selection; an older failure cannot replace newer feedback. Row is not globally disabled while saving and requests are not cancelled. A write failure is shown inline.
operationContracts.stateAndPersistence: shared setting; hidden agentAccess; default empty map

hostPreferenceWrite.claim: nga/tft uses shared mg/wjt for literal host local. For other hosts it gets qf, cancels its query, optimistically clones config.desktop[key], then sends config/batchWrite with replace, configWriteTarget.filePath or null, expectedVersion:null and reloadUserConfig:true. Failure restores the prior snapshot. Finally it invalidates three host keys, plus worktree-list/environment-related keys when changing worktreeRoot.
hostPreferenceWrite.scopeQualification: Static selected host-write contract. Actual remote configuration receiver, file path, durable flush and consumer effects remain unobserved.

worktreeConversationDiscovery.claim: cn pages nonarchived thread/list with limit100 and rejects repeated nextCursor. sn lists pins then reads each pinned thread. on merges/deduplicates normal lists and pins. an optionally enriches via ln only when a non-special host has threadAttachmentOwners capability, requires connected state for that path, polls every minute and disables retry. ln processes root/owner reads in batches of ten and checks the supplied abort signal between requests; no server-side cancellation is proven.
worktreeConversationDiscovery.scopeQualification: This is support for worktree browsing, not an extra user feature. Native cwd links, attached links, pin priority and unpinned subagent filtering are separate rules; it is not an exhaustive owner census.

serializedPreferredViewerWrite.claim: O7s/Rw chains through a WeakMap keyed by queryClient, reads current preferredViewers when its queued turn starts, merges [host/extensionKey]:viewer and writes through mg/wjt. It stores a caught promise so later work continues after failure, while returning the original rejecting promise to the caller. Independent queryClient instances are not serialized by this selected function.
serializedPreferredViewerWrite.scopeQualification: Queue logic replayed with synthetic reads/writes; actual cache isolation, cross-window races and disk durability remain unobserved.

shortcutEditAndReset.claim: Vt sends set-codex-command-keybinding {commandId,update} and reset-codex-command-keybindings. Success seeds the codex-command-keymap-state cache and refreshes it and global-dictation-hotkey-state; hotkey-window state is additionally refreshed for its row and global reset. ve exposes conditional set/append/replace/remove/reset/clear payloads, conflict checks, annotation-mode validation and capture cancel; capability and presentation constrain available actions.
shortcutEditAndReset.scopeQualification: The command receiver, physical key capture/normalization, OS registration and durable keymap backend remain explicit boundaries; no actual keybinding is changed.
